summary: Iter105 verification of the new 'push indoor rides UP to Strava' feature + samples persistence + no-regression on connections/BLE. Backend 7/7 pytest PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter105_strava_push_and_samples.py). Verified: (1) POST /api/workouts/summarize with 60 telemetry samples (power/hr/cadence/speed) + elapsed=60 returns 200 with an 'id'. (2) GET /api/rides/history?limit=1 returns the newest ride with a non-empty 'samples' array (per-second track persisted) and a numeric 'avg_hr' > 0. (3) GET /api/connections/strava/ride-status?ride_id=... returns 200 {connected:false, can_write:false, synced:false, pending:false} for the demo rider (Strava not connected). (4) POST /api/connections/strava/push {ride_id} returns HTTP 400 'Strava is not connected' (NOT a 500). Also POST /api/connections/strava/push {} (missing ride_id) returns 400. (5) PATCH /api/connections/strava/settings {strava_auto_push:false} returns 200 with the strava account view; GET /api/connections lists strava (kind=cloud_oauth) present. (6) Regression: GET /api/connections lists strava + apple_health + health_connect (name EXACTLY 'Google Health (Health Connect)') and NO google_fit. Frontend regression @1280x900 (demo@roujaune.app/demo9900): /connections still renders provider-strava with connect-strava button; BLE demo works — device-btn-trainer opens ble-panel Modal portal, ble-scan surfaces Demo Smart Trainer + Demo Heart Rate + Demo Cadence within 2.5s; no red-screen, no pageerror events. StravaPushButton correctly renders null on summary because connected=false (per agent-to-agent note) — not tested/expected. NOTE: connect-strava button label is now 'Connect' (iter104 showed 'Set up') meaning STRAVA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are now provisioned in preview env (is_configured=true) — this is consistent with the new feature intent (the rider must reconnect Strava with activity:write), NOT a regression.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/workouts.py:_save_ride_history correctly persists a compact ~1 Hz track (samples[::step][:3600]) capped at 3600 points; safe for a 1h ride.
routes/workouts.py:_save_ride_history spawns asyncio.create_task(auto_push_strava(uid, rid)) fire-and-forget after captured uid — no ContextVar leak into background task.

routes/connections.py:strava_push guards: (a) 400 if missing ride_id, (b) 400 if not connected, (c) {reauth_required:true} if connected but no activity:write scope, (d) 404 if ride missing, (e) idempotent {already:true} if strava_activity_id already set, (f) 502 wraps upstream Strava upload failure — no 500 leaks.
routes/connections.py:_do_strava_push chooses upload_tcx when samples present else create_manual_activity — clean split.
providers/strava.py:build_tcx renders per-second TCX with Watts/Cadence/HeartRate/Speed extensions — matches Strava's TCX ingestion format; omits HeartRate/Cadence tags cleanly when 0.

providers/strava.py:upload_tcx polls status up to 6×1.5s (~9s) — reasonable; returns status='processing' if not ready (surfaces to ride-status.pending true when strava_activity_id absent + strava_status=='processing').
PATCH /api/connections/strava/settings correctly whitelists only disable_route_import/disable_auto_sync/strava_auto_push — no mass-assignment risk.
auto_push_strava short-circuits when strava_auto_push is False OR permissions missing WRITE_SCOPE OR ride already pushed — idempotent + safe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for stated regression (connections renders, BLE demo, no red screen)

seed_data_creation: None. Test creates 1 ride_history doc via POST /api/workouts/summarize (workout='TEST_iter105 push') under demo@roujaune.app.
